title: Chevening Scholarship
subtitle: 1-year Master's degree in the UK
benefits: Return economy flight to the UK
eligibility: Return home for 2 years after the award
deadline: Applications usually open Aug and close early Nov. Check the official site for exact dates.
steps: Write 4 essays: leadership, networking, studying in UK, career plan
Submit on chevening.org before the deadline

title: DAAD EPOS Scholarship
subtitle: Development-related postgraduate courses
eligibility: Degree completed within the last 6 years
deadline: Deadlines differ by course (often Aug to Oct). See the DAAD course list.
steps: Choose a course from the DAAD EPOS list
Apply directly to the university course

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters
subtitle: Study in 2+ European countries
eligibility: Each program sets its own criteria
deadline: Most programs close between Oct and Feb. Check each program's page.

title: MEXT Japanese Government Scholarship
subtitle: Undergraduate, Master's & PhD in Japan
eligibility: Citizen of a country with Japan diplomatic ties
deadline: Embassy track usually opens Apr to May. Check your local Japanese embassy.
steps: Check your Japanese embassy's MEXT notice
Submit documents & pass the screening exam

title: Türkiye Scholarships
subtitle: Bachelor's, Master's & PhD in Türkiye
eligibility: Not already enrolled in a Turkish university at that level
deadline: Usually opens Jan and closes Feb. Check the official portal.
steps: Create an account on the portal
Upload documents and attend the interview

title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
subtitle: Master's & PhD study in the USA
eligibility: Apply through your country's Fulbright Commission or U.S. Embassy
deadline: Each country sets its own deadline (often Feb to Oct). Check your local commission.

title: Swedish Institute Scholarship (SISGP)
subtitle: Master's degree for future global leaders
benefits: SI Network for Future Global Leaders membership
eligibility: Admitted to an eligible Swedish master's
Check the country list each year
deadline: University application usually by mid-Jan, SI application in Feb.
steps: Apply to a master's via universityadmissions.se
Apply to SI with CV, motivation & references

title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
subtitle: Undergrad & Master's at partner universities
deadline: Each partner university has its own deadline.

title: Get Paid to Test Apps with Test IO
subtitle: Find bugs in real apps & websites
steps: Join test cycles and report bugs

title: Get Paid for Your Opinion on UserTesting
subtitle: Share feedback on websites & apps
eligibility: Test availability depends on your profile
steps: Take screener questions to get tests

title: Google Career Certificates
subtitle: Data, UX, IT Support, Project Mgmt, Cybersecurity
benefits: Certificate to add to your CV
eligibility: Apply for Coursera financial aid if needed
steps: Finish the courses & share your certificate

title: Land Your First Client on Upwork
subtitle: Sell your skills to clients worldwide
eligibility: A marketable skill (writing, design, dev, VA...)
steps: Build a niche profile with samples
